newsitem.title: USA: J&J's Retin-A Micro for acne available.
newsitem.headline: J&J's Retin-A Micro for acne available.

text.p: Johnson & Johnson's Ortho Dermatological unit said on Tuesday that Retin-A Micro is now available for the treatment of acne.
According to Ortho, Retin-A Micro is gentler form of its Retin-A treatment.

The new medication, which was cleared for marketing by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration last month, uses Advanced Polymer System Inc's Microsponge system to deliver the maximum strength of the medication with minimal irritation.
It entraps tretinoin, the active ingredient in RETIN-A, in the Microsponge systems, which includes round microscopic particles made of synthetic polymer, and formulates them into a gel.

Ortho said that Retin-A-Mirco is the first prescription product to utilize Microsponge technology and that it minimizes the irritation commonly experienced by patients using the highest strength of Retin-A.
